page.overview:
Who is Garviel Loken?

Garviel Loken was originally the Captain of the Luna Wolves (later Sons of Horus) Space Marine Legion's 10th Company during the last days of the Great Crusade and up until the Istvaan III Atrocity that initiated the Horus Heresy.

Loken was highly regarded as a warrior and commander by both his brethren and his primarch. Admired for his cool head and intelligence as well as his record in battle, he was given the honour of induction into the Mournival, his Legion's cadre of close advisers to their Primarch Horus.

However, after Horus' fall to Chaos on Davin, he was considered too loyal to the old ways -- the ideals of the Great Crusade and the Emperor, to be inducted into the dark conspiracy that was overtaking his beloved Legion.

Assigned to command the Sons of Horus contingent's attack in the first assault wave on Isstvan III, he rose swiftly to become one of the leaders of the Loyalist faction comprised of those Luna Wolves, Emperor's Children, World Eaters and Death Guard Astartes who refused to betray the Emperor of Mankind and serve the Ruinous Powers.
